title: 当AI成为武器：他如何用AI来检测AI攻击
carouselChartTitle: 当AI成为武器：他如何用AI来检测AI攻击
author: 阿星
content:
90年代开始搞网络安全。

那时候还是 ethical hacker。

从那以后，

他建了4家安全公司。

每一家都 tackle 下一个大浪潮——

从网络安全到云安全，

现在到 AI。

这是 Oliver Friedrichs 的故事。

**【第四家安全公司：Pangea】**

2021年 launch Pangea。

使命是 make it easier for developers

 build secure cloud applications。

当时看到 developer population 在爆炸性增长——

2700万且还在增加——

意识到没有为他们设计的 security platform。

从那以后，

他们建了将近两打 developer-focused security services，

 for applications——

从 file scanning 到 authorization。

但然后，AI adoption 开始爆炸。

**【转向AI安全】**

公司正在组织里建成百上千的 AI applications，

这种 rush 创造了 massive security risks——

 around data leakage、prompt injection、sensitive information disclosure。

Traditional security tools 对此 equipped。

他直接 parallel 他在 anti-malware 空间的经验。

当病毒和恶意软件80、90年代刚出现时，

是新威胁。

他们必须 create new detection technology detect that threat

 because it didn't exist before。

这个新威胁相似——

 only，words are weapons now

 instead of the bytes they used to detect with antivirus products。

AI security 是新 frontier，

所以他们 pivot focus specifically on——

 helping teams build and secure AI applications and agents

 from the ground up。

今天，Pangea 提供 unified AI security platform，

让 developers 和 security teams 都能 secure GenAI，

 security products 覆盖 homegrown AI workloads

和 employee adoption of AI technology。

Expect to cross 7 figures in ARR this year。

**【用AI检测AI威胁】**

Core innovation 是认识到——

可以用 generative AI detect AI threats。

他们 fine-tune much smaller models——

大约3亿参数的 models——

 detect multilingual prompt injection threats

 across almost 100 languages。

在 Symantec、Cisco、McAfee 等公司运营 research teams

 detect malware 多年后——

他们声称99.9%+的 efficacy——

现在可以为 prompt injection detection 声称同样的 effectiveness。

Challenge 是还没有 real third-party testing body，

所以他们建了四个 main categories of protection 的 AI guardrails：

1. **Prompt injection**——OWASP top 10 for large language model threats 的 #1 威胁。

2. **Confidential information and PII detection**——检测超过50种 confidential information，
   
   options block、report，或用 format-preserving encryption encrypt。

3. **Malicious content filtering**——和 CrowdStrike 等公司合作 integrate threat intelligence。

4. **Topic alignment**——确保 content 和 organizational intent 对齐。

这些 protections power 他们最新的产品设计给 security teams——

 AI Detection & Response (AIDR)，

deploy across range of sensor form factors

 such as apps、agents、endpoints，etc.，

 feed into unified policy and detection engine

 help enterprises gain visibility、threat detection、

 and control over the use of AI in their environment。

**【为规模而建】**

他们建了这个平台——

 internet-scale ready，

 incredibly developer-friendly。

Think Stripe 和 Twilio-like experience，

 where anyone can sign up，get an auth token，

 and start using their API immediately，

 embedding guardrails into their AI applications。

有几个 integration options：

- **API-first** with SDKs in Go、Python、JavaScript、Java、C#

- **AI gateway integrations** for Kong、LiteLLM、Portkey等

- **MCP proxy** to scrub and secure model-generated content

- **Browser extension** to monitor shadow AI usage

- **Deployment flexibility**——locally run with Kubernetes/Helm
  
  或 use their hosted SaaS

平台也支持 protection for AI gateways such as Kong and LiteLLM，

 integrates the Pangea SDK for application-level AI security，

 ingests OpenTelemetry log formats

 enhance observability across cloud-native environments。

也支持 integration with common SIEMs

 like CrowdStrike、NextGen SIEM、Splunk。

Goal 是 fit into existing infrastructure。

**【快速演变的市场】**

一个大挑战是 landscape 变化有多快。

每个 model 都有不同的 guardrails，

新的不断出现。

比如，

Claude 目前是 hardest to bypass 的之一。

Others？Not so much。

You can't assume the model itself will keep you safe。

总有 new threats discover。

比如，Pangea Labs 的一个 AI security researcher

最近 discovered an exploit called LegalPwn，

 affects many common models

 and bypasses their malicious content filters

 by mimicking legal notices triggered。

Generally speaking，

组织 facing two major categories of AI security risk：

**Workforce AI risk：**

 Like shadow AI，

 where employees using unvetted third-party tools

 and unknowingly feeding them confidential data。

**Homegrown AI workload risk：**

 Building proprietary software and systems on top of AI，

 such as customer-facing chatbots，

 creates new risks like prompt injection attacks。

**【多管齐下的增长】**

他们采取 multi-pronged approach to growth：

- **Developer community engagement**——让 API incredibly easy use and integrate。

- **Security team focus**——Targeting CISOs and product security teams。

- **Educational content**——Classified 169 prompt injection methods
  
  and released resources for the community。

- **Open source contributions**——Prompt Lab testing tool
  
  helps establish credibility。

他们 secured strategic partnerships with CrowdStrike

 and backing from Google Ventures and Okta Ventures，

 validating their comprehensive approach to AI security。

还在2025年初 launch The Great AI Escape，

 virtual escape room challenge

 showcase real-world prompt injection threats

 in interactive format。

Over $10K in prizes

 and three increasingly tough rooms

 helped drive awareness in fun、developer-friendly way。

**【教育市场的挑战】**

最大的 hurdle 是 education。

很多 teams racing to build with AI，

 prioritize functionality——

 only to realize later that security is critical gap。

如果能重来，

他会 first go after security teams。

Once security teams see the risks and value，

 they bring developers into the conversation。

**【给你的建议】**

Oliver 的建议：

- **Build with scale in mind from day one。**
  
  Even if you're starting small，
  
  architect your system handle enterprise-scale traffic。

- **Focus on developer experience。**
  
  Whether you're selling to developers or not，
  
  making your product easy to integrate is crucial。

- **Know your market's maturity。**
  
  AI security is only top of mind
  
  once things move to production。

- **Lead with education。**
  
  Sharing what you know builds trust。

最重要的是——

 security can't be an afterthought with AI。

The speed、scale、and autonomy of this tech

 mean risks can multiply faster than anything we've seen before。

Guardrails need to be built in from the start。

**【未来：为AI环境建基础设施】**

随着 GenAI，

我们正在见证历史上最快的软件采用曲线——

但也是增长最快的 security blind spot。

这就是为什么他们刚 launch Pangea AIDR

 alongside their guardrails for AI applications，

 research arm Pangea Labs 也在 ramping up——

 driving new protections for emerging threats

 like image injection attacks on LLMs，

 and offering AI red teaming services。

GenAI 正在 everywhere embedded，

 security incidents 开始 making headlines

只是时间问题。

他们现在正在建 infrastructure prevent that。

**【你为AI安全准备好了吗？】**

Oliver的故事告诉我们——

每一波技术浪潮，

都伴随着新的安全威胁。

从病毒到恶意软件到AI。

关键是——

 stay ahead of the curve。

不是等出问题再 fix，

而是在设计时就 embed security。

你呢？

你在用AI建产品吗？

你有考虑 security implications 吗？

还是只 focus on functionality？

记住——

在AI时代，

security 不是可选项。

是 necessity。

*P.S. 想保护你的AI应用？

去 pangea.cloud 看看。

也许你会发现，

AI security 比想象的更 complex。*

**鏂囩珷閰嶅浘锛?*
